name: SendFox
line: Creator newsletters, automated campaigns and transactional email beta.

free.text: Free for 1,000 contacts and 3,000 emails per month

cells.api: Yes, limited free REST API; app-email beta needs approval

subs.math: 1,000 subscribers × 4 = 4,000 emails. The Free plan's 3,000-send limit is too low for this. Pro 1 includes 5,000 contacts and 100,000 sends.
20,000 sends fit inside Pro 1's 100,000 monthly emails and 5,000-contact capacity.
10,000 subscribers × 4 = 40,000 emails. The Pro 2 plan's 15,000-contact tier is needed, not send volume.
200,000 emails to 50,000 subscribers. Pro 3 includes 400,000 sends.

appmail.math: 3,000 API emails use up the Free plan's 3,000-send allowance. Beta approval and a verified domain are required. No other sends fit.
10,000 API emails use 10,000 of the 100,000 shared Pro 1 sends. Beta approval and a verified domain are required.
50,000 API emails use 50,000 of the 100,000 shared Pro 1 sends. Beta approval and a verified domain are required.
100,000 API emails use up Pro 1's 100,000 shared sends. Beta approval and a verified domain are required.
